message.darkspawn.mount_flying_mounted: Mount: movement keys to steer, jump to rise, Descend / Land to lower. Sneak dismounts.
message.darkspawn.mount_ground_mounted: Mount: movement keys to steer, jump to hop. Sneak dismounts.
message.darkspawn.woolly_rhino_mounted: Woolly Rhino: movement keys to steer, jump to hop. Sneak dismounts.
message.darkspawn.flying_squirrel_mounte: Flying Squirrel: jump or leave a ledge to glide. Movement keys steer; Descend / Land dives. Sneak dismounts.
message.darkspawn.mount_swimming_mounted: Swim: movement keys to steer, jump to rise, Descend / Land key to dive. Sneak dismounts. Bring your own air supply.
message.darkspawn.mole_mounted: Move to steer. Hold Mount: Dig (default V) while moving to tunnel. Shift dismounts.
